To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SLPI expression is significantly increased in patients with advanced gastric cancer.

(i) secretory leukocyte proteinase inhibitor (SLP1) expression is overexpressed in human gastric cancer and its expression level is correlated with tumor invasion; (ii) SLPI overexpression is associated with lymph node and distant metastases; (iii) SLPI overexpressed gastric cancer patients have poor prognosis; and (iv) SLPI enhances the invasive and metastatic abilities of gastric cancer cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of SLPI in gastric cancer and its potential as a biomarker for gastric cancer.
the development of a new biomarker for gastric cancer.

the development and evaluation of a new method for the determination of the concentration of secretory leukocyte proteinase inhibitor (SLI) in human plasma using a new, sensitive and specific enzyme‐linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) technique.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SLPI is overexpressed in human gastric cancer and that it may play a role in cell invasion and metastasis.
SLPI is a useful biomarker for detection, diagnosis and prognosis of gastric cancer, and that SLPI may be involved in the metastatic process in gastric cancers.
SLPI overexpression is associated with gastric cancer progression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the overexpression of secretory leukocyte inhibitor (SLPI), a serine proteinase inhibitor, was associated with the depth of wall invasions, lymph node metastasis and tumor stage in patients with gastric cancers.
SLPI expression is a potential prognostics marker in patients with gastric cancers.
SLPI expression is associated with gastric cancer progression and metastasis, and may be a potential biomarker of prognosis for gastric cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SLPI protein is a potential marker for the diagnosis and prognosis of gastric cancer.
the expression of SLPI in gastric cancer is associated with lymph node and distant metastasis and is a potential prognosticator for gastric cancer.
secretory leukocyte inhibitor is a potential prognosticator and a potential therapeutic target in patients with gastric adenocarcinoma.
